cards.text: King Solomon has died, and his son Rehoboam reigns in his place (2 Chronicles 9:31). Now Rehoboam heads to Shechem, because all Israel has gone there to make him king. Crowning day, friend, and the WHOLE guest list showed up!
Then Jeroboam son of Nebat hears about it. This is a man who had fled from King Solomon, and now he's coming back.

cards.question: Jeroboam son of Nebat had fled from King Solomon, and now he comes back from ___.

cards.text: So Jeroboam is sent for, and he and all Israel come to Rehoboam with a request. Friend, that's the biggest group chat ever to show up in PERSON.

cards.question: Jeroboam and all Israel tell Rehoboam that his father Solomon put a heavy yoke on them. What do they ask the new king to do?

answers.text: Lighten the burden his father put on them
Build them a new city in the north
Lead them to war against their enemies

cards.question: Israel warns King Rehoboam that they won't serve him, no matter what he does.

cards.text: Rehoboam answers, “Come back to me in three days.” Three days to decide a whole kingdom, friend, and I take longer than that picking SPRINKLES.

cards.question: While the people are gone, King Rehoboam asks for advice. Who does he go to first?

answers.text: The elders who had served Solomon
The priests who served at the temple
The prophets who served the LORD

cards.question: The elders advise King Rehoboam to answer the people with ___ words.
The elders say that if Rehoboam pleases the people, they will be his servants forever.

cards.text: But Rehoboam rejects the elders' advice. Free wisdom from his dad's own advisors, friend, and he tosses it like a PERFECT batch straight into the trash!

cards.question: King Rehoboam rejects the elders' advice. Who does he ask next?

answers.text: The young men who grew up with him

cards.text: Rehoboam asks the young men how to answer the people, and they tell him to say, “My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist!” Friend, that's not advice, that's a man flexing in the gym mirror.

cards.question: The young men also tell Rehoboam what to say about the heavy yoke his father put on Israel. What is it?

answers.text: He will leave it as it is

cards.text: Day three, and Jeroboam and all the people come back, just like the king told them to. A whole crowd waiting on one answer, like me staring through the oven door at a fresh batch.

The king answers them harshly, rejecting the elders' advice and speaking as the young men advised: “Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.” Whips to SCORPIONS. The sequel NOBODY asked for. But friend, there's more going on here than one stubborn king.

cards.question: King Rehoboam doesn't listen to the people. This turn of events is from ___.
This turn of events is from God, so that the LORD might fulfill the word He had spoken through Ahijah the Shilonite, a prophet (1 Kings 11:29). Who had that word been spoken to?

cards.text: When all Israel sees the king won't listen, they answer: “What portion do we have in David, and what inheritance in the son of Jesse?” That's King David, Solomon's father, and Jesse was David's father.

cards.question: All Israel asks King Rehoboam what portion they have in David. What do they do next?

answers.text: Turn from David’s house and go home
Stay and plead with the king again
Ask for three more days to decide

cards.question: Even after Israel goes home, Rehoboam still reigns over the Israelites living in the cities of Judah.

cards.text: Then King Rehoboam sends out Hadoram, who was in charge of the forced labor, but the Israelites stone him to death.

cards.question: Hadoram, the man in charge of the forced labor, has been stoned to death. What does King Rehoboam do?

answers.text: Flees in his chariot to Jerusalem
Calls the elders back for advice
Goes out to speak with the crowd

cards.text: So Israel was still in rebellion against the house of David when this was written. And friend, Rehoboam's story is only just getting started.
